name: Phantom Echoes
source:
Rana lives in a village surrounded by a vast forest when strange things happen, sandwiching her between parents' concern and peer’s judgement.
Will she keep her sanity intact while discovering the truth?

[From [url=https://morrowshore.itch.io/echoes]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
拉娜生活在一个被广阔森林包围的村庄里，每当奇怪的事情发生时，她就会夹在父母的关心和同龄人的评判之间。
在发现真相的同时，她会保持理智吗？

[来自[url=https://morrowshore.itch.io/echoes]Itch.io[/url]]
